item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:15 PM, 30 October 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Dinalupihan, Morong, and Hermosa), Batangas (Bauan, San Luis, Mabini, Santa Teresita, Taal, Ibaan, Lipa, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Taysan, San Nicolas, Tingloy, Lobo, Mataasnakahoy, Lemery, Agoncillo, Calaca, Balayan, Lian, Calatagan, Tuy, and Nasugbu), Cavite (Silang, Amadeo, General Trias, Indang, Trece Martires, and Mendez), Pampanga (Angeles, Porac, Bacolor, Santa Rita, Guagua, Lubao, Floridablanca, and Sasmuan), Quezon (Lucban, Sampaloc, Tayabas, Pagbilao, General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Lopez, Gumaca, Calauag, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Plaridel, Unisan, Atimonan, Pitogo, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Buenavista, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Mauban, and Lucena), and Zambales (San Marcelino, San Narciso, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, Subic, Olongapo, Botolan, and Cabangan) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Batangas (San Pascual, San Jose, Cuenca, Alitagtag, and Batangas City) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
